additional_sources.title: Petrodec UK Ltd: Annual Environmental Statement 2024
additional_sources.guard: Official OPRED-hosted statement explicitly reports 2024 operator-scope decommissioning GHG: 3,314 MTCO2eq total, 3,190 MTCO2eq engine/fuel-use emissions and 124 MTCO2eq venting. Total and components share one double-count group and are not summed together; offshore/decommissioning activity is not an England cadastral parcel.

additional_sources.title: THREE60 Energy Wells UK: Environmental Performance Report 2024 Annual Public Statement
additional_sources.guard: Official OPRED-hosted report states zero atmospheric emissions produced from diesel consumption under THREE60 direct Well Operator control and attributes host-facility emissions to the relevant Duty Holder. Because no pollutant-specific unit is printed for the zero summary, it is retained as a negative-control source and not promoted as a measured GHG quantity row.

additional_sources.title: Exceed Torridon Ltd: Well Operator Annual Environmental Report 2024
additional_sources.guard: Official OPRED-hosted report defines Exceed's 2024 Well Operator scope, excludes host-facility emissions reported by Installation Operators/Duty Holders, and reports no drilling or decommissioning operations as Well Operator. No numeric GHG row is invented from non-quantified scope statements.

additional_sources.title: Heidelberg Materials UK: 2024 Scope 1 CO2 intensity by business line
additional_sources.guard: Official Heidelberg Materials UK sustainability data publishes 2024 Scope 1 CO2 intensity in kg CO2 per tonne of production by business line. These are measured intensity/context rows, not absolute tonnes and not facility or cadastral parcel emissions.

additional_sources.title: Environment Agency: Palm Paper Saddlebow Paper Mill permit variation EPR/FP3132UE/V013
additional_sources.guard: Current Environment Agency notice identifies Saddlebow Paper Mill, Poplar Avenue, Kings Lynn, PE34 3AL, England and permit EPR/FP3132UE/V013 for the regulated Paper & Pulp installation. This strengthens onshore England facility identity/binding only; the permit notice itself is not an observed GHG quantity.

guard_contract.MEASUREMENT_CANDIDATE: Explicit scope, pollutant/gas, quantity, unit, period and provenance are required. Intensity metrics must remain intensity metrics and cannot silently become absolute emissions. Offshore/non-England measurements cannot become England cadastral parcels.
guard_contract.BINDING_CANDIDATE: Permit/address/facility data supports identity and onshore binding only; no emissions quantity is implied.
guard_contract.SPATIAL_CANDIDATE: Map/grid/boundary data supports spatial matching only; no measured emissions quantity is implied.
guard_contract.SOURCE_UPGRADE: Zero/no-operations/host-attribution or non-quantified statements are useful guards but cannot become measured GHG rows without explicit pollutant, quantity and unit.

web_research_basis: Fresh public internet research on 2026-07-27 using official GOV.UK/OPRED, Environment Agency and official operator sustainability sources. Petrodec explicit 2024 GHG totals/components are retained with double-count protection. THREE60 and Exceed are negative/scope controls. Heidelberg 2024 Scope 1 intensity is isolated from absolute emissions. Palm Paper adds current onshore England permit/address binding. PDF screenshot calls were attempted for analyzed PDFs; cache misses are recorded, with machine-readable official text used and no OCR or graph-axis inference.
